method: OWASP ZAP Dynamic Scan and Dependency Audits
defence: Intermediate Misconfiguration and Vulnerable Dependency Protection

justified_findings: pytest==8.3.4 (Dev-only tool, upgrading breaks async plugin)
pip_audit.verification: pytest suite passed 23/23 tests after upgrades

justified_findings: minimatch (Dev-only eslint dependency, not in production build)

findings_and_justifications.justification: Vite dev server does not inject headers by default. The production FastAPI backend successfully injects X-Frame-Options: DENY, verified via curl.

findings_and_justifications.alert: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
findings_and_justifications.justification: Generated by the third-party Swagger UI library loading external CDN assets. Cannot be modified without breaking the auto-generated docs.

zap_scan.interpretation: The dynamic scan confirmed that the actual API routes are protected by the custom FastAPI middleware. Alerts generated are expected artifacts of local development servers and third-party libraries.
